quotations: ASML reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $13.06 billion USD (€11.66 billion), up 55% year-over-year and 25% sequentially. The company's gross margin reached a record 57.5%, up from 51.6% a year earlier, while operating income rose to $5.79 billion (€5.17 billion). "Looking further ahead, we shared our intent last quarter to increase our capacity in 2027 by 30% for both Low NA EUV and DUV immersion systems, as well as to investigate adding a further 30% in 2028," explained Roger Dassen, Chief Financial Officer at ASML. "However, given the dynamics of this quarter, we now anticipate that our current planned levels of output in 2027 and 2028 will not fully meet the demand of our customers."
